annotation.title_clean: Government Strengthens Civil Service Capacity for Responsible AI Governance
annotation.title_en: Government Strengthens Civil Service Capacity for Responsible AI Governance
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item on a June training programme in Dhaka for Bangladeshi civil servants and procurement officials on AI literacy, ethics and governance, linked to the Readiness Assessment Methodology and implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: UNESCO and Bangladesh launched AI literacy and ethics training for civil servants on 15, 16 and 18 June.
The RAM process identified public official capacity development as a key requirement for AI adoption.
Training supports implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
The Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority plans to use AI in the e-GP system.
The programme is EU-funded and delivered via UNESCO's AI Ethics Experts Without Borders network.
